# Cost-aggregator PromQL series <-> producer contract (B-181).
#
# loop-console's cost aggregator (internal/billing/cost_aggregator.go, the
# `promQueries` map) runs one PromQL query per cost metric. The queries NAME
# `loop_runtime_*` series; the producers that would EMIT them live in this repository.
# Nothing joined the two sides, so a query naming a series nobody emits
# returned an empty vector every five minutes and `cost_counters` stayed at
# zero by construction -- silent on both sides.
#
# Measured 2026-09-05 against k3d-loop-runtime-core: all three queries returned
# {"resultType":"vector","result":[]}, and Prometheus knew 48 `loop_runtime_*` series
# names, none of them the three queried.
#
# This file is the pin. The `cost-series-producers` gate
# (cmd/loop-runtime-ops/internal/quality/costseriesproducers) reads it and answers,
# for every series the aggregator queries, exactly ONE of three things, and
# says which:
#
#   PRODUCER <path>  the query names a series this repo emits. The gate OPENS
#                    <path> and verifies the metric is declared there. A
#                    producer path that does not declare the series FAILS, so
#                    this column cannot decay into prose.
#   ABSENT <item>    the query names a series NO repository emits, and the
#                    absence is tracked under <item>. Printed on every run.
#                    If a producer ever appears, the gate FAILS asking for
#                    this line to become a PRODUCER line -- a closed gap must
#                    not keep an open ledger entry.
#   (unlisted)       a series the aggregator queries that is absent from this
#                    file FAILS the gate.
#
# The third case is the point of the file: it freezes the mismatch B-181
# measured, so the gate catches the NEXT mismatch instead of re-reporting this
# one forever. A permanently red gate teaches that red is normal.
#
# Format: <series>  PRODUCER <repo-relative path>
#         <series>  ABSENT <work item>
# Histogram/summary-derived series (_sum, _count, _bucket) resolve to their
# base metric name when the producer is looked up.

loop_runtime_egress_bytes_total          ABSENT B-181
loop_runtime_docr_pulls_total            ABSENT B-181
loop_runtime_build_duration_seconds_sum  PRODUCER api/internal/metrics/build_metrics.go
